raw:
Agent Name: WebSurfer  
Step Number: 2  
Reason for Mistake: WebSurfer prematurely concluded that "Bitter Jester" is exclusively a documentary film based on the first search result. However, other results on the webpage mentioned the "Bitter Jester Music Festival," which suggests that "Bitter Jester" could also be related to music. WebSurfer failed to explore and verify all the search results comprehensively, leading to an incomplete understanding of the term "Bitter Jester." This oversight caused the Planner to incorrectly finalize the shared media type as "documentary" without considering the possibility of other media types.
